Correlation Risk#

Dependence✓ Mathematical
◆ The PatternCorrelations shift in crises — diversification can vanish when you need it most

// Correlations shift in crises — diversification can vanish when you need it most

In calm markets, asset correlations are moderate and diversification works. During stress, correlations spike toward 1 — a phenomenon called correlation breakdown.

Copula models separate marginal distributions from the dependence structure, allowing non-linear tail dependence to be modeled explicitly. Regime-switching models capture correlation shifts.
